Archival Dispatch: 32 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Early Recordings, American History, Ripley's One-Minute Curiosities, and The Story Lady

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 5 min
Tags: Early Recordings, Victor Acoustic 78s, Cavalcade of America, You Are There, Apollo 11, Truman, Ripley's Minute, Story Lady, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 36 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 36 resolves 32 acoustic discs and radio master broadcasts: 8 pre-1920 acoustic 78 RPM recordings from Early Recordings (featuring Billy Murray, Ada Jones, Alma Gluck, Henry Burr, and the Original Dixieland Jazz Band), 8 historical radio documentary dramas and speeches from American History Through The Eyes Of Radio (including DuPont's Cavalcade of America, CBS's You Are There, President Truman's 1945 peace address, and live Apollo 11 moon landing audio), 8 syndicated sixty-second curiosities from Ripley's Believe It or Not - One Minute Episodes (Spring 1948), and 8 children's radio fables from The Story Lady (Summer 1949).

1. Early Recordings — 1902–1919 Acoustic 78 RPM Pioneer Discs

Master acoustical recordings from the dawn of the recording industry:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate / Session Acoustic Pioneer
Early_Myers_Minnehaha.mp3 "J.W. Myers: 'Minnehaha' (Victor Monarch Acoustic #1783)" 1902-11-12 Baritone pioneer J.W. Myers sings early acoustic ballad.
Early_Murray_Dixie_Land.mp3 "Billy Murray: 'Dixie Land, I Love You' (Victor #4864)" 1906-08-20 Famous early acoustic cylinder and disc vocal.
Early_Gluck_Sing_Me_To_Sleep.mp3 "Alma Gluck: 'Sing Me to Sleep' (Victor #74224)" 1911-09-14 Soprano Alma Gluck's million-selling acoustic master.
Early_Jones_Murray_ABCs.mp3 "Ada Jones & Billy Murray: 'The ABCs of the USA' (Victor #17042)" 1912-03-26 Classic vaudeville comic duet recorded in Camden, NJ.
Early_Kline_Murphy_Have_A_Heart.mp3 "Olive Kline & Lambert Murphy: 'Have a Heart' (Victor #18287)" 1917-04-18 Jerome Kern Broadway theatrical vocal duet.
Early_ODJB_Indiana.mp3 "Original Dixieland Jazz Band: 'Indiana (One-Step)' (Columbia #A2297)" 1917-05-31 Landmark early New Orleans jazz band recording.
Early_Peerless_Quartet_Stay_Away.mp3 "Peerless Quartet: 'I May Stay Away a Little Longer' (Victor #18413)" 1918-01-15 WWI barbershop and harmony vocal patriotic standard.
Early_Burr_Campbell_Blowing_Bubbles.mp3 "Henry Burr & Albert Campbell: 'I'm Forever Blowing Bubbles' (Victor #18603)" 1919-07-22 Beloved postwar American pop hit recorded for Victor.

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate Historical Documentary Drama

American_History_Resourcefulness.mp3 "Cavalcade of America: Resourcefulness in Frontier Industry" 1938-03-23 Industrial development and mechanical ingenuity on the frontier.
American_History_Golden_Ocean.mp3 "The American Trail: The Golden Ocean (Chapter 6)" 1953-02-15 Wagon train pioneers heading west across the Cumberland Road.
American_History_Monitor_Merrimac.mp3 "You Are There: Battle of the Monitor and the Merrimack (March 9, 1862)" 1948-03-07 CBS news style reenactment of the Ironclad duel off Hampton Roads.

American_History_Truman_Peace.mp3 "President Harry S. Truman: 'A Just and Lasting Peace' Address" 1945-09-01 Formal White House radio address following Japanese surrender.
American_History_Apollo_11.mp3 "Apollo 11: Neil Armstrong Moon Landing Live Audio (July 20, 1969)" 1969-07-20 Live mission audio from Eagle lunar module touching down at Tranquility Base.
American_History_Gerard_Peril.mp3 "James W. Gerard: 'The German Peril' Historical Address" 1917-10-15 Historic wartime address by former US Ambassador to Germany.
